fee_notes: Royalty is 7% of monthly Gross Sales or Minimum Monthly Royalty, whichever is greater. Minimum Monthly Royalty is $300/month from commencement through month 35, then $600/month for months 36 through end of term. Exceptions: Franchise Option Program pays 11% of Gross Sales for initial 5-year term and first renewal; Conversion Franchise Program pays 2% of prior month Gross Sales or $150/month minimum (whichever is greater) for first 3 years only. Brand Fund Fee is 2% of monthly Gross Sales. Technology Fee is $500/month (may be waived for second or contiguous territories); includes 4 email licenses; additional licenses at $15/month each. Field Service Software is $99/month per tenant account plus $350/month per 1,000 customers. Payment Processing Fee is $35/month per account plus per-transaction fees (2.99% + $0.29 per credit card transaction; 1% for e-check). Digital Marketing Services: $305/month (basic) or $595/month (higher tier) per territory, plus optional $49/month add-on tool. Digital Lead Generation Services: 20% of total advertising spend or $100/month, whichever is greater. Convention Fee: up to $1,500/year. Transfer Fee: $5,000. Renewal Fee: 20% of then-current initial franchise fee. Most fees subject to annual increase cap of 10% with 30 days notice.
raw_excerpt:
Continuing Royalty Fee 7% of your monthly Gross Sales: -or- the Minimum Monthly Royalty, whichever is greater. Due monthly no later than the first day of the month after billing. See Note 2 and Note 3.
Brand Fund Fee 2% of monthly Gross Sales. Due monthly no later than the first day of the month after billing. See Note 2.
Technology Fee $500 per month. Due monthly no later than the first day of the month after billing. See Note 4 and Note 13.
Additional Email Licenses $15 per month per license Due monthly no later than the first day of the month after billing. See Note 4 and Note 13.
Payment Processing Fee $35 per month per account and applicable per transaction fees Due monthly no later than the first day of the month after billing. See Note 6 and Note 13.
Renewal Fee 20% of the then-current initial franchise fee. Before renewal If we decide to renew your franchise.
Additional Initial Training $500 per attendee, per day. Before the training See Note 7 and Note 13.
Vehicle Wrap Fee $250 per month until the vehicle wrap is properly completed. On demand Only payable if you fail to wrap your vehicle(s) within 120 days after you sign the Franchise Agreement.
Late Submission Fees $100 per violation, plus the lesser of 12% interest per year, or the maximum rate allowed by law from date due until paid. On demand.
Audit Amount Underpayment amount and lesser of 12% interest per year or maximum rate allowed by law. Cost of audit if you understate Gross Sales by 2% or more. On demand.
Management Fee Cost of our representatives to operate your Franchised Business, not to exceed $5,000 per day. On demand.
Customer Complaints Amount we incur to remedy customer complaint. On demand.
Transfer Fee $5,000. After our approval of transferee and before transfer.
Indemnification Will vary under the circumstances. On demand.
Cost of Enforcement or Defense All costs, including attorneys' fees. Will vary under the circumstances. Upon demand.
Field Service Software $99 per month, per tenant account, plus $350 per month per 1,000 customers. Upon demand by the vendor or due monthly.
Insurance The amounts we pay for insurance on your behalf. Upon demand.
Collection Fees Amounts we incur to collect amounts you owe us. Upon demand.
Convention Fee Up to $1,500 per year depending upon costs. Due at registration.
Relocation Fee Amount equal to our costs in evaluating proposed location for relocation of Franchised Business, not to exceed $5,000 per request. Upon demand.
Guarantee Remediation Fee Amounts we incur to satisfy guarantee of products or services. Upon demand.
Investigation Costs Amounts we incur to review alternate products, services and suppliers upon your request, not to exceed $5,000 per request. Upon demand.
Digital Marketing Services $305 per month, per territory or $595 per month, per territory, depending on the level of service, plus $49 per month for additional optional tools. Due monthly.
Digital Lead Generation Services 20% of total advertising spend or $100, whichever is greater. Due monthly.
Refurbishment Fee $500 per default Upon demand.
Phone and Messaging Services $34.99 per month per user, plus $0.012 cents per text message. Due monthly.
Email Marketing Services $169/mo. for up to 5,000 emails Due monthly.
Postcard Marketing Services $199/mo. for up to 120 postcards. $1.65 per additional postcard. Due monthly.
